trigger: Phase 2 is open for exactly one reason: NLU latency (candidate_b_structured / nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b, P50=19150ms, P95=66983ms per artifacts/v2/nlu_frozen_config.json's gate_results_dev_split_post_fix.latency). Human approved testing whether NVIDIA currently exposes a fast, non-reasoning (or reliably reasoning-disableable) model through the existing NVIDIA_API_KEY credential.
constraints: Phase 3 not begun regardless of outcome
model_discovery_method: Live GET https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1/models with the existing NVIDIA_API_KEY (82 models returned, 2026-09-24), followed by live single-call tests of each promising candidate. A previously-discussed candidate name ('nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b') was explicitly NOT trusted from memory - it was independently found in the live model listing, then live-tested for callability, latency, reasoning behavior, and structured-output support.

candidates_discovered.architecture: hybrid Mamba-2 + MoE with select attention layers; native Multi-Token-Prediction speculative decoding
candidates_discovered.active_params: 3B active of 30B total (documented on HF/NVIDIA blog - developer.nvidia.com/blog/nvidia-nemotron-3-5-lightning-delivers-fast-accurate-specialized-task-execution-for-long-running-agents)
candidates_discovered.structured_output: response_format={'type':'json_object'} documented (JSON mode); this experiment used strict Pydantic post-validation over free JSON text, matching candidate_b's existing mechanism, since ChatNVIDIA's LangChain wrapper does not expose response_format cleanly for this model in the installed SDK version
candidates_discovered.reasoning_behavior: reasoning-capable by default - live test with default settings produced response.additional_kwargs['reasoning_content'] of 1187-1269 chars and 11.7-27.8s single-call latency
candidates_discovered.reasoning_disable_mechanism: OFFICIAL, documented: chat_template_kwargs={'enable_thinking': False} passed as an OpenAI-compatible chat-completions request field (confirmed against https://docs.nvidia.com/nim/large-language-models/2.0.10/get-started/advanced/get-started-nemotron-3.5-lightning.html). NOT a prompt-text convention like the prior round's '/no_think' or 'detailed thinking off' system message (both previously found unreliable - the system-message form was re-tested this round and again failed to suppress reasoning, latency 27.8s, reasoning_content 1267 chars). The documented API-level parameter, once correctly routed through langchain_nvidia_ai_endpoints as an invoke()-time kwarg (llm.invoke(prompt, chat_template_kwargs={'enable_thinking': False})), reliably produced reasoning_content='' and 1.30s single-call latency in this round's live test. Passing it via LangChain's own `extra_body=` invoke kwarg failed with a 400 'Unsupported parameter(s): extra_body' - it must be passed as a direct top-level invoke() kwarg, which ChatNVIDIA forwards into the request body.
candidates_discovered.free_endpoint_status: NOT PUBLISHED as free/paid tier explicitly in fetched docs; empirically reachable and billing to the same account as the existing frozen nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b model, which the frozen config's own comment documents as free-tier (40 RPM cap, no daily cap)
candidates_discovered.quota_documented: DOCUMENTED (shared account-level, not model-specific): NVIDIA NIM free tier caps requests at 40 RPM with no published daily cap, per config/llm_config.py's existing comment (same account, same header used for both models)
candidates_discovered.quota_account_specific_observed: NOT SEPARATELY OBSERVED this round beyond the existing 35 RPM client-side limiter already in config/llm_config.py, which applies uniformly to any model called through get_llm()
candidates_discovered.quota_not_published: Model-specific RPM/RPD/TPM/TPD ceilings distinct from the account-level 40 RPM figure are NOT PUBLISHED for this specific model in any fetched official source

candidates_discovered.note: Listed in the live /v1/models response but returns 404 Not Found ('Function ... Not found for account ...') on actual invocation - listed but not currently servable to this account/key. Not usable regardless of its other properties.

candidates_discovered.structured_output: not tested in depth (candidate rejected on latency before this was needed)
candidates_discovered.reasoning_behavior: reasoning-capable by default; live test produced reasoning_content=465 chars
candidates_discovered.reasoning_disable_mechanism: OpenAI gpt-oss models officially support a 'reasoning_effort' chat param (low/medium/high) per OpenAI's own gpt-oss docs, but this was NOT tested live this round because the model's default-setting single-call latency (42.95s) was already worse than the current frozen model's P50, making it a weak candidate regardless of a reasoning-disable option; DEPRIORITIZED in favor of the clearly faster nemotron-3.5-lightning result obtained first
candidates_discovered.free_endpoint_status: NOT PUBLISHED distinctly from account-level tier
candidates_discovered.quota_documented: same account-level 40 RPM figure as above; no model-specific published figure found

selected_experimental_candidate.reasoning_setting: chat_template_kwargs={'enable_thinking': False}, passed as a direct invoke()-time kwarg (nlu/extractor.py::extract_candidate_e_nvidia_fast)
selected_experimental_candidate.response_format: free JSON text (identical mechanism to candidate_b_structured: STRUCTURED_EXTRACTION_PROMPT + strict Pydantic ResearchQuery validation), not provider JSON-schema mode - chosen for parity with the frozen architecture so latency/quality differences are attributable to the model swap and reasoning setting alone, not a simultaneously-changed response-format mechanism

cross-source question, multi-entity (BTK inhibitors, type 2 diabetes)

pilot_source_split: evaluation/v2/nlu_benchmark_v1.json 'dev' split (45 examples) - the allowed Phase-2 dev split, never the consumed 105-example test split, never Phase-10 data

reject_immediately_if: schema-valid-but-semantically-empty output (valid JSON shape with hollow/near-empty field values - the exact Qwen-1.5B failure mode)

latency_gate.rule: P50 must be unambiguously, materially better than the control's 19150ms - not a marginal reduction like ~15s. No frozen hard numeric threshold exists in the contract; the bar is 'clearly material, ideally low-single-digit-second typical latency with a drastically tighter tail', per this round's directive.
latency_gate.pilot_single_call_evidence: 1.30s observed on one live call with reasoning disabled, vs 11.7-27.8s for the same prompt/model with reasoning enabled, vs 19.15s P50 for the control - qualifies as unambiguously material if reproduced across the pilot set

revision_rules: Only if pilot failures are purely formatting/schema-integration issues (not semantic)
Never add exact failed benchmark questions as few-shot examples
Never change the taxonomy to suit the model
full_dev_criteria: Run the full 45-example dev split ONLY if the 8-example pilot passes every quality gate AND the latency gate.
rejection_rule: Reject if either quality or latency fails on the pilot, or if full-dev quality regresses materially against the control's hard gates (entity F1 near 0.9008 with no per-type collapse; fabricated IDs always 0; no systematic B/G or other >=80% single-class confusion; constraint F1 near 0.788-0.818 with no important field collapse; semantic_roles preserved; ambiguous abbreviations handled safely; structured output highly reliable and semantically valid).
selection_rule: HARD quality gates decide eligibility first (pass/fail, not a composite score). Only among candidates passing every quality gate does latency decide. No single weighted/composite score is used for the accept/reject decision, per the explicit Phase 2 reopening lesson (see docs/v2/PHASE2_REOPEN_ANALYSIS.md).
